$comment: See arc-testnet-evm.json. A Verifier Profile describes and does not authorise.
specIdNote: not applicable to the SVM guest; present so tooling can fail loudly rather than default.

predicate.description: A Solana account's lamport/token balance must rise by at least `min`, measured by re-executing the committed instruction against a committed account set.

proving.requires: SP1 toolchain and ~6.2 GB of Groth16 artifacts in ~/.sp1

knownLimits: The guest recomputes a bank_hash over the account set THE DEAL NAMED. That is internal consistency, not provenance: an account set we invented hashes just as well as a real one, and there is a test asserting it. This does not establish that the inputs came from Solana mainnet.
The buyer names the verifier — see arc-testnet-evm.json.
This verifier judges SVM proofs only. An EVM deal binding cannot settle here; the vkey is immutable and one verifier adjudicates one guest.
howMeasured: verifier codehash and vkey read from the chain. The codehash was not previously recorded anywhere; this is its first measurement.
